tools.name: read_kundli
tools.description: Vedic birth chart (Kundli) at a glance from date, time and place of birth: rising sign (lagna), Moon sign (rashi), nakshatra, the planet period (Vimshottari dasha) running now, and where each planet sits. Use when someone asks about their chart, rashi, nakshatra or dasha.

tools.name: life_timing
tools.description: Times one life question from the Vedic chart: marriage, money (career and income), abroad (travel and settling overseas), love, job (job change), sade-sati (Saturn phase and when it ends) or year-ahead. Returns a verdict, the nearest strong window to the month, the strongest month, the planet reason

tools.name: match_kundli
tools.description: Marriage compatibility of two people from their birth details: Ashtakoot Guna Milan score out of 36 with all 8 kootas, Nadi and Bhakoot dosha, and each person's Mangal (Manglik) dosha with cancellations. Use for "match me with my partner", "kundli milan", "are we compatible".
